worldcombat.skill.lunge.summary: Coils its legs, throws its whole body at the target and lands with all its weight: the hit deals contact damage, shoves the target back and lowers its Attack by one stage. Full-force mode is heavier, shoves further and lunges further, but is slower.
worldcombat.skill.lunge.use.0: Pounce in and cut a target's physical output
worldcombat.skill.lunge.use.1: Bowl a single tough target over and leave it swinging weak
worldcombat.skill.lunge.use.2: Close the gap before the target can
worldcombat.skill.lunge.description.0: The pounce deals %1$s contact damage on impact.
worldcombat.skill.lunge.description.1: Leaps %1$s blocks toward the target (%2$s blocks per tick), with a %3$s block collision radius; a miss simply stops at the landing spot.
worldcombat.skill.lunge.description.2: On a hit it shoves the target %1$s blocks along the lunge and lowers its Attack by %2$s stage.
worldcombat.skill.lunge.heavy.on: Full-force: power x1.18, knockback x1.35 and lunge x1.12 for one heavier, longer blow; costs +3 wind-up, +3 recovery and +8 cooldown ticks.
worldcombat.skill.lunge.heavy.off: Nimble: power x0.92 with a faster cast and shorter cooldown, good for chasing agile targets.
worldcombat.skill.lunge.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s wind-up it recovers for %3$s, spends %4$s PP, and goes on cooldown for %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.lunge.growth.0: From level %1$s the pounce rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.lunge.growth.1: From level %1$s the pounce rises again to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.lunge.preference.heavy: On: power x1.18, knockback x1.35 and lunge x1.12 for one heavier, longer blow; costs +3 wind-up, +3 recovery and +8 cooldown ticks. Off (nimble): power x0.92 with a faster cast and shorter cooldown, good for chasing agile targets.
worldcombat.skill.lunge.preference.ai.ma: The companion only lunges once the target is within this distance; larger values jump earlier and miss more often into the wrong spot.
worldcombat.skill.lunge.preference.ai.fi: On: a target with a lower health ratio ranks higher, so this heavy blow goes for the kill. Off: ordinary melee ordering.
